scope: Read-only review of all eight entries and all 66 complete cases, including exact actors, Changqing/Guishan ownership, term-specific openings, #0g, senses, work identity, anchors, and per-sense aliases.

findings.finding: The complete biography proves that Changqing Da'an, not Guishan Lingyou, is the speaker: it calls him Fuzhou Da'an, narrates his questioning of Baizhang, his years assisting and succeeding at Guishan, and then his first-person 'I lived at Guishan for thirty years' ox account. The opening preserves that distinction. Six works keep one identifiable ox through taming, questioning, bellowing, feast, and snow deployments; aliases and anchors are adequate.

The action 'see one's nature' and noun phrase 'faculty/nature of seeing' are different grammatical referents and correctly split. Direct, quoted, and rejected outside claims retain exact layers. The opening surfaces the corpus's challenge to a separate seer and seen nature without imposing doctrine; aliases distinguish both segmentations.

Withered-tree image versus Master Kumu Cheng is a required word/person split. Revival and lifelessness are opposing predicates of the same tree, not extra senses. All three person rows are correctly compiler-owned, the opening explains the Zen test against mistaking dead stillness for completion, and search aliases separate image from name.

Anatomical heel/location and abstract footing or independent stance are genuinely different things, each supported by four works. The governing verbs and predicates justify the split, actor attribution is exact, and aliases cover heel, beneath-the-feet, footing, stance, and following another's heels.

The structural unspecified triad and five separately constituted master-linked triads are distinguishable referents, not different readings of one set. Each PreferredTarget names its members or ranking. Yunmen's conventional attribution is carefully qualified by the Deshan Yuanming formulation evidence; Wuzhu's official questioner is not made a master. Single-work senses are explicitly provisional rather than falsely multi-source.

Seeking a point of approach and components temporarily coalescing are different events with different subjects and objects. The first sense's interview pressure and denied foothold are well surfaced; Du Kuang is correctly a named lay questioner. The second sense is honestly marked provisional because its parallel witnesses transmit one statement.

Continued guarding/maintenance and vouching for something are distinct acts. Changqing Da'an is correctly the questioner to Baizhang, not Guishan; the full case explicitly identifies Da'an and only later narrates his Guishan residence. Furong/Guizong and Dahui/Xin'an roles are also exact. The opening preserves conflicting answers, including rejection of maintenance, without splitting by master.

One close-woven/gapless quality covers definition, critical reports, house style, phrase appraisal, reduplicated form, and no-wind formulation. The textile image's transfer to speech and presentation is explicit, Dahui's criticism is not flattened into endorsement, and no independently attested literal fabric object requires another sense.
